alignments.note: Genitive pronoun object of the preposition.
Inferential conjunction; the projection carries r00-base, which keeps the word the ASV renders.
Hortatory subjunctive: the auxiliary *let*, subject *us* and the verb's own particle *up* are rule 7/9 helpers; rule 17 heads on the lexical verb *offer* rather than the auxiliary.
Anarthrous Greek, so the supplied *a* is an ordinary rule 7 helper on the noun it determines (rule 51's anarthrous clause), not a determiner read off an article.
Genitive noun rendered *of + noun*; rule 17 heads on the noun and the case preposition rides along.

`διὰ παντός` → *continually*: one English word answering to neither the preposition nor the quantifier separately, so rule 45 joins them headed on the governed word. Aligning *continually* to `παντός` alone with `διά` `unrepresented` is the competing reading; rule 45 forbids it in terms, and rule 94's precondition is met since the ASV writes a single word.
The ASV gives `θεῷ` no determiner, so the article has no *the* to anchor and is `unrepresented` under rule 23; rule 21 forbids leaving a bare *to* on it.
Dative noun; the case preposition *to* stays with the noun under rule 21's determinerless clause.
Substantival demonstrative subject of the explanatory clause.
Anarthrous Greek; the supplied *the* is a rule 7 helper on the noun under rule 51's anarthrous clause.
Genitive plural rendered *of lips*, headed on the noun with the case preposition riding along.

Attributive participle recast as a finite relative clause: the relativizer *which* and the light verb *make* are helpers on the participle under rules 7, 9 and 31 (no article stands here to carry the relativizer). Rule 17's support-verb clause heads on the meaning-bearing complement *confession*, as `μαρτυρέω` → *bear witness* heads on *witness*.
`τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ` → *to his name*: the genitive pronoun is free and displaces the determiner under rule 20, so the article realizes nothing.
Dative noun with its case preposition; discontinuous across the possessive under rule 15.
Genitive pronoun realized by the possessive *his* under rule 20.

review_notes: Every s### and t### is partitioned exactly once; t001–t026 and s001–s018 all accounted for.
`διὰ παντός` is the one contested unit: taken as `noncompositional` under rule 45 rather than splitting *continually* onto `παντός` with an `unrepresented` `διά`.

Both `unrepresented` units are articles emptied by rule 23 (determinerless English) and rule 20 (possessive displacement) respectively; a reference comparison will report them as disagreements and that is not a correction.
Heads reviewed separately from edges: *offer* over *let*, *confession* over *make*, nouns over their case prepositions.
